caption: The video captures a clear tumbler glass resting centered on a light wooden tabletop, set against a textured pinkish-beige wall. The glass holds a translucent yellow liquid filled to roughly two-thirds, with a pale, rounded ice cube floating in the lower-right portion of the drink. A faint band of condensation clings to the upper exterior of the glass, catching the warm indoor light. The thick base glows yellow where the liquid pools. Throughout the captured moment, the visible arrangement appears largely unchanged: the rim, the liquid meniscus, and the floating cube stay in much the same positions. Reflections and highlights on the glass surface show little change, and the table-and-wall boundary remains near-fixed, leaving the scene as a quiet study of the chilled drink.
relations: The tumbler rests centered on the tabletop, so its rim and base positions persist relative to the wall boundary.
The pale cube floats in the lower-right liquid, so its position and the meniscus remain largely unchanged.
Condensation clings to the upper exterior, so surface highlights and reflections show little change under warm light.
The thick base pools yellow liquid, so its glow persists throughout the captured moment.
